tei:div.tei:p: "$ (73)༄༅// blo sbyong gyer bsgom rdo rje'i glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(74)༄༅// kwa ye pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba ma lus drang ba'i phyir// bdag la yod pa'i nyon mongs dug lnga gang dag gis// sems can rnams kyi dug lnga ma lus drang bar bya// 'dod chags la sogs med pa'i dge ba gang yod rnams// 'gro drug sems can rnams la snyoms par bram par bya// na tsha la sogs 'bras bur gyur pa'i sdug bsngal gyis// de dang rigs mthun sdug bsngal ma lus drang bar bya// na tsha la sogs med pa'i phan bde gang yin de// 'gro drug sems can rnams la rtag tu brim par bya// de ltar byas na rang nyid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir// skad cig tsam yang 'khyams pa'i go skabs ga la srid// 'on kyang ji srid byang chub ma thob bar// myong gyur nyon mongs rgyu 'bras ji snyed pa// thams cad skye ba 'di la yongs su rdzogs par bya// de yang da lo'i zla ba 'di la drang bar bya// de yang de ring da lta nyid du rdzogs byas nas// sdug bsngal brang bred rabs chad tsam gcig thabs su bsten// blo 'di 'byongs par gyur cig byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa// zhes byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems gyer sgom rdo rje'i glu blang ba 'di byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa bdag gis yun du kha ton byas nas/ re zhig chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du thugs rje chen (75)po dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das byams pa lha'i rgyal po'i cha lugs su zhugs nas byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa can byon nas 'di skad gsungs/ thos pa tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i glu// bsam pa tsam gyis 'khor ba'i ljon shing bcad pa'i glu// sgom pa tsam gyis byang chub myur du 'byin pa'i glu// byams pa snying rje byang chub sems kyi glu 'di mtshar// nyon mongs dug lnga dgra bzhin 'joms par rigs na yang*// khyod kyis 'di ltar na ni rgyud la brten par 'tshal// na tsha sdug bsngal kun nas bzod par dka' na yang*// khyod kyi 'di ltar na ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// rang don yal bar dor nas gzhan don lhur mdzad de// rang dbang med par 'khor bar 'khyams pa su mi dka'// des na rang don bsam pa skad cig ma 'khris par// gzhan gyis mi 'dod bdag gis len pa dam pa yin// theg pa chen po'i gsung rab mtha' yas mu med kyang*// 'di ru ma 'dus rdul tsam gang yang yod ma yin// de phyir rnal 'byor khyod kyi rdo rje'i glu blangs 'di// thos bsam bsam gtan bsgom pa'am bshad kyang rung*// 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa'i skyabs gnas dam pa ste// phyogs bcu'i rgyal (76)ba rnams kyi thugs kyi snying khu de// khyod kyi blo la shar ba ngo mtshar shin tu che// shin tu dgyes pas rdo rje'i gla tshig gi lan du gsungs pa dang*// byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa shin tu nyams dga' zhing the tshom gyi mdud pa grol nas dpa' bo chen po rdo rje'i g.yul du zhugs so// kye ho yang 'di ltar nyin len gsum mtshan lan gsum dus dang gnas skabs dran pa dang brjed pa ma mchis par chos 'di blo la sbyangs shing khams gso rdo rje'i glu blangs pa dang*/

lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po dang*/ sha za dang*/ srin po la sogs pa ma rang gi bu gcig pu la byams bzhin gus par dbang du 'dus par gyur to// gzhan yang yul gyi rgyal po dang*/ btsun mo dang*/ bram ze dang*/ khyim bdag dang*/ khye'u bu mo dmangs rigs la sogs pa thams cad dbang du 'dus te// dga' bas rjes su 'brang zhing mthong ba dang thos pa thams cad byams pa'i rang bzhin du gyur to// gzhan yang rta dang glang po ma he spre'u 'dab chags chu ru skyes ri'i sems can gcan zan gyi tshogs tha na grog sbur yan chad 'gro ba rigs drug rang la mi 'jigs shing bag phebs pa ltar rnal 'byor pa'i drung du 'khor bar gyur to// de ltar rnal 'byor pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la bdag gi byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'di la byas tshig kha ton du byas// snyan pa rdo rje'i glu blangs pa la brten nas thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das byams pa'i zhal mngon sum du bstan// dgyes pa'i gsung phyung nas the tshom gyi drwa ba thams cad bcad// de la brten nas kho bos bzod pa dang brtson 'grus la sogs pa zla ba yar ngo bzhin du 'phel bar gyur// de'i dbang gis 'di ltar 'gro ba rigs mi mthun (77)pa thams cad kyang mas bu mthong ba bzhin du bdag la kun dga' bar gyur// de dag gi bzang len du bcom ldan 'das byams pa la theg pa chen po'i mchod pa bul bar dgongs nas rdo rje'i glu blangs pa ni// thog med dus nas nye bar 'brel ba yi// pha mar gyur pa'i sems can ma lus pa// byang chub mchog la 'god pa'i yi dam bsam// chos 'dis byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi// de tshe rang don skad cig ma 'khris par// gzhan don 'ba' zhig goms par bya// 'di ni byang chub sgrub pa'i gtso bo yin// chos 'dis byams pa mgon la mchod par bgyi// bde sdug btang snyoms tshor ba ci byung yang*// byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs su dang du blang*// bskal pa du mar bsod nams ci gsog kyang*// nyan thos sdar ma'i chos su ma shor bar// chos 'dis=

/de tsam zhig tu mi 'dod ci byung yang*// bzod pa'i go cha cung zad shor ma gyur// lhag par drin gyis bskyangs pa'i skye bo yis// log sgrub byed kyang 'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis skyong*// chos 'dis= /sdar ma'i skye bos phyogs nas sdig bsags kyang*// ngan pa'i bsam pa skad cig ma shor cing*// snang srid bdud dang lha 'dre dgrar langs kyang*// rang 'dod 'khris pa'i srung skyob byed ma myong*// chos 'dis= /nges par 'chi ba'i nad kyis btab gyur kyang*// chos min dag la yid brtan bca' ma myong*// ser sna goms pas 'byor pa chung na yang*// log pa'i chos la lto gos byed ma myong*// chos 'dis= /ngan pa'i grogs kyis kun nas bskor na yang*// gnyen po'i rang tshugs gang yang skyel ma myong*// mdor na 'gro 'am 'dug gam ci byed kyang*// ma brtags bya ba gang yang byed ma myong*// chos 'dis= /de ltar yin mod 'on kyang chos rnams la// bden par rtog pa rdul tsam yod ma myong*// 'di ni byang chub sgrub pa'i gtso bo yin// chos 'dis= /de ltar sgrub pa'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis// (78)rnal 'byor bdag gi bsam pa sbyang ba'i phyir// byams pa'i dpung gis yon 'di bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas blo 'di 'byongs par mdzad du gsol// zhes pas mchod pa dang*/ bar snang la mchod pa'i lha mo lnga dang*/ sgra dang 'od la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba'i mchod pa gzhan yang dpag tu med pa'i rnam par gyur to// de'i tshe theg pa chen po la blo 'byongs pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams chos 'di ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su rig nas 'di'i phyogs su dka' ba spyod pa dang zhu zhing nyams su lan pa yang du ma byung mod// de'i nang nas gnas chen po brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi bdag po paṇḍi ta lnga bcu rtsa gnyis kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ chos rgyal drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis mnga' gsol ba'i dpa' bo// 'dul ba 'dzin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mkhan po/

mdo sde 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa'i bshes gnyen/ mngon pa 'dzin pa mtha' yas pa'i bskur gnas rig pa 'dzin pa rgya mtsho'i bla ma/ mdor na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i skyes bu dam pa 'gro ba'i mgon po a ti sha la gnang nas thugs rje chen po des thugs nyams su bzhes te/ de yang rang don yal bar dor nas gzhan gyi don lhur mdzad pa de ni bdag gi bla ma lags zhes pa la sogs pa de ltar lags so// skyes bu dam pa des rgya bod kyi sa cha la skyes bu dam pa don du gnyer ba rnams la lkog khrid du gdams pa'o// brgyud pa ni/ byams pa// byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa// des jo bo rje la'o/ ༈ /byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i nags su dka' thub bzod// skye bo yongs de rang 'dod 'joms// mi 'dod 'jigs pas mi brdzi ba// dpa' bo rnams la gus btud nas// bde gshegs lam srol skyong ba'i phyir// rgyal po snying stobs chen po ltar// gzhan don 'ba' zhig rab bsams nas// bdag gzhan nges par brje bar bya// de la bdag rgyud rengs pa nges// bcud kyi bdag po dpa' bo la// bde gshegs gsung rab dbang bzhag nas// yus pa'i tshig (79)gis gdams 'di zhus// e ma dpa' bo snying rje can// bdag gis chags pa'i gnas rnams spangs// 'jigs pa'i lam la dka' ba spyad// phyogs las rgyal te drung 'dir slebs// nang ni nad kyis mnar ba yi// log sgrub skye bo bzod pa'i phyir// mi gtsang 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab tu// mi phod brdzi ba'i chos gcig zhus// snying rje chen pos len gsungs pa// dka' ba spyad nas 'ong ba la// 'jigs dang dub pa spang ba'i phyir// blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa yod// kha sbub snod de thos pas zlog /zhabs rdol snod de bsam pas drubs// spags pa'i snod de sgom pas khrus// snod kyi skyon spangs bcud 'di longs// kwa ye thog ma med dus nas// da dung bdag rgyud ma thul nas// gshis ngan bdud kyi khang pa na// nyon mongs las kyi pho nya 'khor// khyod kyi pha ma ma bsam pas// sems can thams cad sdug bsngal kyang*// da dung bag phebs bde gyur te// gnyen po go cha mi gon a// de ni gyod brdal chen po yin// phyin chad bzlog pa'i go ba longs// bdag rgyud 'gong po ma thul na// pha ma'i srog la brab po a// rang gi bde skyid 'joms nges a// 'khor ba'i gting rdo mchi'o a// gshis ngan rang mgo ma 'chings na// thams cad dgra bor langs gyur te// dug mda' snying la zug pa'i tshe// nges par lung bar mchi'o a// rang 'dod khyi rkun ma phyung bar// gnyen po'i sgo chad ma gyur kyang*// nang du phung khrol byung ba'i tshe// sman chad dug tu 'chor ro a// dug lnga'i srog rtsa ma chod par// le lo blo rgya bskyed gyur kyang*// tshe thung rlung gis khyer ba'i tshe// snying nas 'gyod pa mchi so a// de ni bslab bya chen po yin// phyin chad sems la brtag gzhig 'tshal// rnam rtog bdud (80)kyi rgyal po yin// gshis ngan las kyi gshin rje yin// rang 'dod dug gi sdong po yin// skyon rnams sems dang le lo can// tshe 'di che thabs bslu brid yin// srung skyob mang po mgo bskor yin// lha 'dre mang po brdzun bring yin// rnam rtog dgra ru ma langs shig

/byas pa'i las la zin pa med// skyong ba'i 'khor la khrel gzhung med// bsags pa'i nor la snying po med// phung shig gzhal gyis thob cig a// 'chi bdag rang gi snying la gnas// srog ni rang gis gcod par byed// dug chu rang gis 'thung bar byed// nges par bdud 'di som zhig a// 'di ni nyams myong chen po yin// bdag gi nyes dmigs bshad pa yin// gtam 'di 'jigs par rab bsams nas// phyin chad go bar 'tshal lo a// nges par snying la bsam pa yin// bya byed mang po srog la gzan// gang la'ang phan sems ma mchis pas// stong chen mang po mi kha sdang*// pho tshugs gnyen po med pa yi// grogs po ngan pa chos la gzan// 'dod yon sdug kha ma khengs pa'i// chos pa'i gzugs brnyan rgyu la gzan// byas shes bka' drin mi bzo ba'i// khrel med de ni yongs la gzan// rang don yal bar ma dor ba'i// gzhan don tshig gis bslu'o a// blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las// gzhi nyon mongs pa gtan la dbab pa'i chos yongs su rdzogs so// ༈ /blo sbyong sems dpa'i rims pa las bzlog phyogs gnyen po'i chos bzhugs so// snying rje'i gdung ba sman gcig po// bdag lta thul ba'i gnyen gcig po// chags sdang skyob pa'i lha gcig po// gnyen po'i rtsa ba chod la 'dud// nyon mongs rnam rtog skyes pa'i tshe// rgya khras bye'u ded pa ltar// dmigs su bkor la (81)bkar ded gyis// lag tu zin te brlag par gyis// don rtog snying la zhen pa'i tshe// dgra rkun ngos 'dzin byed pa ltar// dbyibs dang spu ris phye mdzod la// phyin chad rtog pa med par gyis// bzang rtog dgra ru langs pa'i tshe// gshed ma bur brdzus zin pa ltar// zin ma thag tu mgo gnon la// srog gcod rtog pa med par gyis// skyid 'dod le lo byung ba'i tshe// ston g.yog gnyid log bslangs pa ltar// bsdad pa'i skabs med drag 'chun gyis// rnam grol las la 'da' bar bya// tshe 'di'i che thabs sgrub pa'i tshe// srin po mi zan mthong ba ltar// ldang zhing las de'i 'phro bzhag la// mi khom las la rgyang ring bros// zla dang g.yeng bas khyer ba'i tshe// g.yul ngor mi ro mthong ba ltar// grogs dang bcas la rab sdang zhing*// dben pa'i nags khrod brten par bya// chags sdang bdud kyis g.yengs pa'i tshe// khyi smyon dug sbrul mthong ba ltar// 'khor ba'i bde la rgyab phyogs kyis// btsan pa myang 'das dbyings su bros// rtag 'dzin brtson rar bsdams pa'i tshe// rgyal pos dong du mnar ba ltar// nam 'chi cha med rab bsam la// yid 'byung skyo shas drag po bsten// thos bsam lo 'dod shor ba'i tshe// zlos gar mkhan gyis bshad pa ltar// lag len med par rab bsams nas// rang la khrel bdas chen po bya// nyin mtshan chos la 'bad gyur kyang*// da dung skya dri ma yal na// bdud kyis khyer bar rab bsams la// bzlog ste gnyen po bsten par bya// byas pa chos la bsam gyur kyang*// ci byas log par song gyur na// 'gong pos khyer bar rab bsams la// nges par dkon mchog ra mdar sbran// bla ma'i grwa sar bsdad gyur kyang*// mkhan slob grogs po ltar (82)bcos pa'i// chos la chags sdang gsog gyur na// bdud las bsams la nags khrod bsten// rtse gcig sgom sgrub byas gyur kyang*// da dung grol cha ma rnyed na// thos pas gol sa ma rnyed skyon// bsams la bzlog ste zab mo blta// blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las// bzlog phyogs gnyen po'i chos rnams yongs su rdzogs so/

༈ /blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las// rang rgyud ngan pa dma' dbab pa'i chos bzhugs so// rang 'dod 'khri ba ma zhugs pas// theg dman lta bar ma ltung zhing*// srid pa'i brtson rar ma bsdams pa'i// grol ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// nga'o zhes pa mgo bskor yin// dgos shes bya ba ngo dga' yin// gzhan ma zhes pa dgra tshig yin// mi dgos zhes pa bar chad yin// bdag gzhan ces pa 'byed tshig yin// chags sdang zhes pa 'khrugs pa yin// de 'dra'i rnam dbye su byed pa// de ni zab mo'i chos las nyams// mkhas pa dgra bo 'joms 'dod na// dang bod bdag khyad du bsad// gang gis bskur ba btab gyur kyang*// de la dag tshang rnams mi byed// gang gis gnod pa bskyal gyur kyang*// kha 'dzin shag 'debs yang mi byed// lus srog longs spyod bral gyur kyang*// rang gis bsags pas len no zhes// lhag par rang la snying tshim bsgrang*// gang gis 'dre gdon rbad gyur kyang*// de la 'khu 'khrig mi bya ste// gzhan gyi bsam pa tshim par bya// mi phod bsam pa brji ba ste// srid dang 'dra ba'i 'khor la sogs// sha la brtse ba 'phrog gyur kyang*// rang la 'gal med snying tshim bgrang*// yon bdag drin len log 'jal tshe// skad cig tsam yang mi 'khrugs par// bzod bskul bka' drin dran par bya// da ni (83)sdig pa spong ba'i thabs// zhe sdang med par dgye bar bya// de ltar bkar gyin byams pa bsgom// rang la snying tshim thi les btab// de ltar bzod pa ma thob bar// grogs ni gshis ngan dag dang 'grogs// de la dmigs rkyen rab byas nas// 'khor ba la yi skyon bsam zhing*// snying rje chen po lhag par bsgom// gnas ma las phug gad skyibs dang*// khang rul thigs pa 'dzag pa dang*// lha khang phyugs lhas 'brog stong dang*// gcong rong yid mi dga' bar bsdad// de tshe shes pa mi dga' zhing*// klung du bsdad na ri la 'gro// der ni sdod snying mi 'dod de// bse dang skyibs dang bzur la snyegs// yang yang sdod sa rab spo zhing*// shes pa mi dga' skye ba na// rang la shag 'debs 'di ltar bya// khyod kyi shes spyod 'di 'dra na// gnas mal 'di yang yang rab yin// blo sems 'di kun bde mo yin// gzhan du khyod kyi sdug bsran 'dis// dmyal bar ma skyes khar rje che// btso bsreg ma myong khar rje che// yid btags bkres skom grong khyer du// bskal par ma skyes khar rje che// mi gtsang srin bu'i grong khyer du// 'dam rdzab chen por rab 'phyo zhing*// bskal par ma skyes khar rje che// gzhan yang 'jigs pa rab bsam zhing*// bdag la khrel bdas chen po byas// lto la gyong bskur dka' thub bya// gos la gyong bskur dma' cha bzung*// bde skyid khyad bsad gnyen po bsgom// bya byed ling bsgyur byar med bsten// ci byed byang chub grogs su bsgyur// blo sbyong sems dpa'i rims pa las// rang rgyud ngan pa dma' dbab pa'i chos yongs su rdzogs so/

༈ /blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las// zag bcas dge ba'i stobs skyed pa'i chos bzhugs so// lus dang srog la mi lta zhing*// rgyal srid bya dga' ma brten par// dka' spyad bzod pa bsgom pa yi// dpa' bo de la phyag 'tshal lo// gtam 'di nyon dang rtag 'dzin can// las (84)'di sems dang khur po can// skye ba gtan gyi sa bon de// tshe thung 'di la sgrub dgos na// long yod brten pa'i snying med pa// gdon 'di gang gis bslad pa yin// sngar yang skyid 'dod ches pas phung*// de ltar yin mod zur mgo rags// da dung gshis ngan ma spangs na// rgyud 'dis shin tu phung ba yin// da dung gzhan don ma bsam par// nga dgos 'ba' zhig brten byas nas// rang gzhan thams cad mgo bskor nas// mnar med gnas su nges par 'jug /tshe 'di'i kha 'dzin shag 'debs kyis// 'dre rtog zur mgo su bas rags// na tsha sdug bsngal su bas mang*// gzer zug sdug bsngal nad du che// tsha grong sdug bsngal dmyal ba 'dra// dbul phongs sdug bsngal su bas che// bkres skom 'jigs skrag yid btags 'dra// dug sbrul khyi smyon nyid dang mtshungs// yod na yod pas skyong phyir sdug /med na med pas 'tshol phyir 'khyams// gang ltar byas kyang sdug bsngal gsos// ci ltar byas kyang skabs don stong*// tsa ba bdag 'dzin ches pas lan// sdug bsran snying rus chung bas lan// byams pa'i zhing sa ral bas lan// snying rje'i rtsa ba chad pas lan// sems bskyed dge ba stor bas len// ma rabs grogs la brten pas lan// de rnams thams cad 'das pa'i chos// 'dun ma brlag zin yar la mchod// da ni su la'ang re ma che// phyi nang gang la'ang dogs ma 'cha'// don med rtog pa'i sngon ma bsu// sngar byas ngan pa'i rjes ma bcad// bdag 'dzin byed ri zhe mna' skyol// ngan shag byed ri zhe mna' skyol// mi la 'jug ri zhe mna' skyol// 'dod yon sems ri zhe mna' skyol// jo bo sems can mar bsams la// sdug byur thams cad rang gis khur// duḥkha thams cad rang gis longs// (85)khrel bdas chen po rang la gyis// soms shig soms shig 'jigs pa soms// bzlog cig sngar bas las ngan zlog

/de ltar nyon mongs rabs chod la// phyi nang dus skabs thams cad du// bdag 'dzin duḥkhas ma bzung zhig /las ngan gsog na khrom du sgrogs// ngo lkog byas na kha dman phob// nang dbyen byas la nangs mtshang shig /spyod ngan dkrug la the les thob// gtsang rtog skyes tshe mdze ros 'dul// gdon rtog skyes tshe gnyen dgu'i 'grim// lcags bro skyes tshe rnag khrag 'jib// kha rgyang ma che bdag 'dzin bsgyur// byin rlabs ma zhu 'dre la byin// mthu bo che la blo ma gtad// mo bon dag la blo ma dbab// drag sngags dag la sems mi gtad// rdzas rang liṅga rang la byas// 'dre gdon nad kyis btab pa na// rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i// khro bo thams cad phyir la khyed// ma hā kā la la sogs pa'i// gtum po thams cad pha tshad khyed// da ni de ring lan chags 'jal// srung skyob ra mda' sbran ri shi /de ring 'khor 'das shan shun 'byed// 'dus shig 'dus shig sha za dang*// dbugs len thams cad rtsa 'dir 'dus// sha bshus rogs la slebs par shog /sha bgos grogs la slebs par shog /khyed rnams nga yi pha ma yin// bu yi sha khrag rol du thog /khyod ni drin can pha ma yin// de ring bzang lan len du shog /sngon chad lus sems gces par bzung*// rgyu des da rung 'khor bar 'khyams// sngon chad bya dga' rang gis khyer// rgyu des da rung na tshas btab// sngon chad gnod pa gzhan la bskyal// rgyu des khur bo ri bas lce// sngon chad byas pa 'gyod lugs la// da ni khu 'phrig bya ri shi// sngon ni bdag 'dzin bsrungs bsrungs nas// kha (86)tsam tshig gi skyabs 'gro dran// da ni skyabs gsum mthu che yang*// da ni bdag 'di'i rgyab mi byed// phung byed 'di yi gting ma rdzi// gal te thugs rjes skyabs byed na// 'dzin pa nang du brlag par gyis// gzung ba phyi ru brlag par gyis// chags ldang rang sar brlag par gyis// phyis ni ldang ba med par gyis// da ni lan chags ston mo 'gyed// mgron ris srid rtse man chad nas// dmyal khams bco brgyad yan chad na// lus dang longs spyod bya dga' dang*// dbugs dang mdangs dang gzi brjid rnams// gang la dgos pa thams cad 'dus// bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu shog

/thog med dus nas gces bzung ba'i// sha khrag 'di la dga' bar rol// lan chags zo la phyis mi snyegs// mgron rigs stong phrag brgyad cu shog /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga shog /gnod sbyin sha za 'byung po shog /pho bdud bdud kyi pho nya shog /mo bdud las kyi srin mo shog /pho bdud rgyal 'gong sa bdag shog /thams cad 'dir shog sha khrag rol// spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas// rkang mthil sor mo yan chad la// kho bo zhen chags mi byed kyis// thams cad bag phobs tshim par zo// sha khyer khrag 'thung rus pa mur// mgo po yan lag don snying khyer// lhu tshigs nang khrol chu ser khyer// mdor na klad pags la sogs pa'i// lus 'di phyi nang thams cad kyi// bza' nyan bca' nyan thams cad la// khu 'khrig ma byed tshims par rol// zhi bar gyis la brlag par gyis// phung bar gyis la rtsa ba chod// chom chom myog myog bdag la ya// shag shag tshal pa bdag la ya// rbad rbad thum thum bdag la ya// hūm̐ dzaḥphyis 'di med par gyis// 'khor ba'i 'khor lo rgyun chod cig /las (87)ngan phung po rabs chod cig /sngon chad lus 'di gces par bzung*// da ni bdag nyid brlag par mdzod// ma rungs brlag pa'i mthu stobs can// sha khrag rol pa'i gdug pa can// dbugs len gshed po sa ma ya// khyed kyis bdag 'di chom par gyis// dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams la lhag /khyod kyis bdag 'di ma chom na// rang rang las kyis brlag par 'gyur// da ni shes nas 'jig pa yis// tshogs rdzogs bcing ba grol bar 'dod// de las grol bar ma gyur na// 'dir tshogs gshed ma thams cad kyis// rlung dang mkhris dang bad kan dang*// 'dus pa nad kyi phung po dang*// mi bzod sdug bsngal drag po thongs// snang yul srid pa'i 'khor 'das na// mi 'dod ji snyed yod pa rnams// thams cad bdag gi steng du thongs// 'gro kun nyon mongs las dang ni// sdug bsngal srid pa kheg par gyis// nges par sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal rang gi snying nang du// da lta nyid du smin par shog

/rgyu des 'gro ba ma lus pa// las ngan rgyu 'bras drung phyung nas// spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs par shog /bdag la yod pa'i dge ba rnams// thams cad 'gro ba yongs la bsngo// rgyu des 'gro ba ma lus pa// rtogs pa phun sum tshogs par shog /de ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyi// spangs rtogs phun tshogs thob gyur te// byams dang snying rje chen po'i dpal// chos su nyag gcig thob pa na// de las byung ba'i tshogs gnyis kyis// bdag nyid 'khor bar ga la lus// gang yang byang chub ma thob bar// myong 'gyur nyon mongs rgyu 'bras rnams// tshe 'dir rgyud la smin par shog /tshe 'di'i nyon mongs rgyu 'bras rnams// da lo nyid la smin par shog /de yang (88)zla ba 'di la shog /de yang de ring nyid la shog /de yang skad cig 'di la shog /de ring gzer thung la sogs pa'i// zug gzer drag po myong ba'i tshe// nad 'di 'gro ba yongs kyi nad// sgos khur nyid du blangs pa yin// da ni thog tu phebs pa yin// gtod len gnad du song ba yin// a la la ho nga re dga'// nges par sems can bde ste mchi// sdug bsngal bdag gis lon pa yin// da ni go re bcad do zhes// na tsha skyes pa tsam gyis kyang*// 'os med na tsha 'dus pa yin// na go bdag gis chod pa yin// tsha go bdag gis chod pa yin// bkres skom 'khyag gi chod pa yin// lus la na tsha skyes gyur kyang*// sems kyi dga' ba 'phel bar bya// blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa las// zag bcas dge ba'i stobs skyed pa'i chos yongs su rdzogs so// ༈ //bla ma gser gling pas jo bo la mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i chos su gnang ba bzhugs so// mgon po gser gling ba'i zhal nas// jo bo la bu khyod mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i chos 'di rnams dgos gsungs// rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms te// gnyen po thams cad bcom rdog yin// 'dun ma thams cad gcig 'dril te// lam rnams thams cad gcig chod yin// gnyen po rnam byang gi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// 'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la// snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin// rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen te// 'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul pa yin// na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags ma ste// sdug bsngal chos nyid kyi yo langs yin// kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// skyid kyi kha non chen po ste// sdug gi mjug sdud chen po yin// na na nad (89)g.yog chen po yin// gcig pur sdod na skyo grogs yin// gnyen po log non gyi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// bdag ni las ngan gyi rtsa ba ste// rgyangs kyis bskyur ba'i chos gcig yin// gzhan ni byang chub kyi 'byung khungs te// bcang ste len pa'i chos gcig yin// spang gnyen mjug sdud kyi chos bzhi ste// mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin// log cer log la cir cer ltos// shigs kyis shig la 'bol le zhog

/des ni mi 'ching grol bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so/ ༈ /nyon mongs pa lam du slong ba'i chos bzhugs so// na mo ratna gu ru/ chags sdang gi rtog pa drag po byang chub kyi sems gnyis la brten nas lam du slong ba'i man ngag /sngags nas nyon mongs pa lam du slong tshul bshad zer te/ nyon mongs pa rang ga ma 'di lam du 'gro mi srid/ nyon mongs pas dmigs par byas nas rnam par bzlog pa'i sgo nas lam du byed pa mdo sde nas kyang mang du gsungs/ de'i gdams ngag kyang dang po 'dod chags la mtshon na/ rang rgyud dam dngos po 'ga' zhig la chags par mthong ba'i tshe 'di nyon mongs pa 'dod chags yin/ ma spangs ma sbyangs ma btul na ngan song la sogs pa'i duḥkha dpag tu med pa bskyed pa yin/ sbyangs shing btul na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur ba yin/ bdag gis 'di btul nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bya'o snyam su bsam/ de nas bdag gi dgra zla'i nyon mongs pa 'dod chags rang gi rgyud la blangs/ de nas byams pa bsgom pa bzhin rgya je cher bskyed/ mthar sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags bag la nyal dang bcas pa thams cad rang gi steng du blangs (90)pas rang gi 'dod chags de blos 'khyud tshad kyis chen por bsam/ sems can thams cad 'dod chags dang bral nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bsam/ de ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems yin/ rang gi 'dod chags ri bo tsam de rang gi sems kyis blangs pa yin/ pha rol gyi yang blangs pa yin/ 'dod chags kyi ngo bo yang sems yin sems las logs su rdul tsam yang med/ sems la sems kyis bltas pas 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i sems ni 'gag shig ma skyes bas na med pa/ da ltar pa ni dbyibs la sogs pa'i ngos bzung dang bral ba ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pas nam mkha' lta bur 'dug pa 'dod chags bya ba'i ming tsam yang don du grub pa mi 'dug snyam du bsam pa de'i rang du gnas chad bzhag par bya'o// de ni don dam byang sems yin// de gnyis las rim pa ltar gzugs kyi sku'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis kyang nyon mongs pa zhi bar 'gyur ba'i phrin las dang*// nyon mongs pa bag chags gnas ngan len thams cad spong ba'i chos sku 'byung*// de bzhin du zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad la sbyar bar shes par bya gsungs// bla ma'i gsung nyid lhag chad med par bris pa'o// nyon mongs pa lam du slong ba'i man ngag shin tu zab pa'i don dge legs nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur cig

༈ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor bzhugs so// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir yang theg pa che chung gi chos thams cad nas bla ma gal che bas mtshan nyid de bsten tshul mang du gsungs// sdong po bkod pa las/ skye ba 'dzin pa med pa yi// gru yis pha rol phyin mi nus// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang*// bla ma med pas srid mthar min// zhes gsungs te/ 'jig rten pa'i yon tan rigs mtho ba la sogs pa (91)rdzogs pa'am/ yang na sgrub pa po slob ma'i yon tan dad pa dang brtson 'grus la sogs pa rdzogs pa yod kyang rgyud byin gyis rlobs pa'i bla ma la ma bsten par rtogs pa mi skye ste/ de ma skyes na 'khor ba las mi thar pas bla ma dam pa bsten dgos la mtshan nyid kyang*// bla ma'i mtshan nyid brgyud par ldan// rtogs pa yod na tshad ldan yin// ces rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas brgyud pa bar ma chad par byang chub kyi sems la nges pa brten po yod pa jo bo'i bka' brgyud lta bu la brten dgos de bsten pa'i tshul yang gnyis las/ dang po don gyi sgo nas bsten pa bla ma'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin sgo gsum gyi sgrub pa yin// gsang ba brda'i sgo nas bsten pa ni rang gi snying ga'am spyi gtsug tu bla ma bsgoms nas mos gus byas gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ de la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum las/ sbyor ba la gnyis las/ dang po sems bskyed pa byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ gnyis pa stong ra bcas rang lus snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsam/ snying 'od kyi gong bu lta bur bsam/ dngos gzhi ni spyi bor padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gang mos kyi bla ma bsam/ de sngar mthong ma mthong bye brag gis sku'i tshad ji tsam yin pa'am tshon gang tsam du bsam/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ sku'i bzhugs tshul dang*/ gsung gi nga ro dang*/ thugs kyi dgongs pa thams cad dran par bya// brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas la thug pa man chad chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma thams cad dang*/

yi dam dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang bla ma de dang ngo bo tha mi dad par mos par bya// mchod pa ci 'byor dbul/ de nas thal mo sbyar la bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la skyabs 'gro ci nus (92)bya/ de'i don yang skyon thams cad bral ba yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa don dam par rang bzhin med pa nam mkha' lta bu yin yang bdag cag sems can thams cad kyi don du snang ba yin snyam du bsam// de nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin po che bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rgyud la ji ltar 'khrungs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyud la ji ltar mnga' ba nges don gyi mdo sde rnams kyi brjod bya'i don gyi mthil byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis bdag gi rgyu lnga da lta nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'byor pa/ rgud pa/ mtho ba/ dma' ba/ bde ba/ sdug pa/ na ba/ 'chi ba/ 'pho ba/ skye ba'i dus thams cad du byang chub kyi sems mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rkyen dang bar chad thams cad chos 'di'i grogs su 'khyer shes par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ de nas mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya bcas la tshangs bug kha bye bar bsam/ de'i nang na mar bla ma'i sku 'od kyi rnam pa skar mda' 'pho ba'i tshul du byon nas snying du zhugs par bsam/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos rang 'di yin snyam pa'i dad gus skyes tshad gcig bsgom/ de nas khong klong la bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du gyur bar bsams la gnas tshad du bzhag /gsum pa rjes ni de la mi gnas ni rang gi lus dang snying ga'i bla ma sngar bzhin bsam// yang na spyi bo'i rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam// dus gsum gyi dge ba thams cad bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang chos 'di skye ba'i ched du bsngo ba dang smon lam gdab/

de ltar nyams su blangs pa la brten nas phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab kyang (93)mdor bsdus na thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i phan yon gnyis 'byung*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba thams cad kyis mi tshugs/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thob/ gdams ngag dang rdzas su bstan pa thams cad 'byung*/ dmigs pa gnyis kyi bye brag gis 'od gsal la 'pho ba yin pas 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag 'di nyid yin/ 'di la 'bungs na rang gang 'dod gyi rtogs pa 'char nus gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rtogs pa gzhan mi dgos gsungs/ sa rin po che spyil bu pa'i zhal nas nga yi snying phyung nas bstan kyang dmar lhog lhog kham gcig las mi gda'/ nyams len gyi mthil phyung pa 'di yin gsungs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bla ma'i gsung nyid las yi ger bkod pa'o// chos 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'phags pa byams pa la/ des thogs med la/ des dbyig gnyen la/ ku su lu che ba/ ku su lu chung ba/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje lha gcig dge bshes ston pa/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chang ka ba/ spyil bu ba/ slob dpon lha/ lha sdings dbon/ dharma sidhaṃ/ rgya ston byang chub rgyal mtshan/ mkhan po gzhon nu byang chub/ rin chen 'byung gnas dpal bzang po// des buddha ratna/ des kirt+ti shī la la/ des dza ya bha dra/ des puṇye ratna la'o// sarba maṅga laṃ//(94)
